alumni.title: Alumni
alumni.description: Politehnica University of Bucharest is pleased to announce the launch of the UPB Alumni Community platform — an online networking platform.

shop.title: Shop
shop.description: The UPB Shop is here for everyone in the academic community who wants to purchase a personalised product featuring the University's insignia.

polijobs.title: PoliJobs
polijobs.description: The only Employment Placement Agency launched by a university in Romania. The agency offers free services exclusively for UPB students and graduates.

ccvsar.title: CCVSAR Volunteering Centre
ccvsar.description: The Centre for Culture, Volunteering, Sport and Recreational Activities was created to combine students' needs with society's interests, encouraging them to take part in activities that build the foundation for personal, professional and social achievements.

upbizz.title: UPBIZZ Entrepreneurship Centre
upbizz.description: The entrepreneurship centre is dedicated to UPB students, with a team determined to create an interactive educational journey for young entrepreneurs, offering them experiences, success stories, knowledge and a lot of passion.

ccoc.title: CCOC Counselling Centre
ccoc.description: Come to CCOC if you want to discover your psychological profile, interests and professional aptitudes, learn more about educational paths and the specialisations offered by UPB, or validate your choices — we support you in making the best decisions!

AcademicResources.title: Academic resources
AcademicResources.description: Publishing, library services, scientific events and publications that support research activity at UPB.

press.title: Politehnica PRESS Publishing House
press.description: The publishing house, with a scientific profile, promotes the results of research activity carried out at UPB.

library.title: Central Library
library.description: 1,340,762 library units (books, periodicals, special collections, standards, audiovisual materials).

events.title: Event Booking
events.description: This service supports those who wish to organise scientific events within UPB.
